description: Wait for pending downloads or list this session's downloaded files. Downloads start by themselves when you click a download link or open a file URL (PDF, CSV, …); this tool never triggers them. download() waits for a pending download to finish; download({ action: 'list' }) returns at once.

action.description: status waits for pending downloads; list: history, never waits (use for polling)

settle.description: Ms to wait for a download to START before reporting none — Chrome fires downloadWillBegin a few ms after the click; 0 = instant

timeout.description: Max wait in ms for pending downloads

name: download
